text:
If he who must paint you must see you, and cannot look without going blind, who can portray you without offending his sight and you?


I wished to make you bloom in snow and roses; but that would honor roses and wrong you; I wished to give you two stars for eyes, but when did stars dream of that?


I knew the impossible in the sketch; but your mirror, by your own radiance, assured success in its reflection.


It can portray you without borrowed light, since in the mirror you are original, painter, brush, and copy.

translation.title: If He Who Paints You Must See You
